method: Match ZIP member to tracked file by basename, byte size, CRC32; verify full matches byte for byte. Partial overlap is a lower bound.

field_contract.archive_bytes: Archive-relative count or byte size, not Git storage cost
field_contract.members: Archive-relative count or byte size, not Git storage cost
field_contract.matched_members: Archive-relative count or byte size, not Git storage cost
field_contract.matched_uncompressed_bytes: Archive-relative count or byte size, not Git storage cost
field_contract.unmatched_members: Archive-relative count or byte size, not Git storage cost
field_contract.unmatched_uncompressed_bytes: Archive-relative count or byte size, not Git storage cost
field_contract.all_members_byte_identical_to_tracked_fi: Boolean; true only after every member was compared byte for byte
field_contract.sample_match: Repository-relative tracked file matching one ZIP member
field_contract.sample_unmatched: Sample ZIP-internal member name without a basename+size+CRC32 match in tracked files
field_contract.git_blob_oid: Git blob object ID; identical ID means no second blob storage

limitations: For partial/no matches, matching uses basename+size+CRC32, so counts are lower bounds. ZIP packaging, timestamps and manifest role are not judged redundant by content overlap alone. Local-only ZIP count includes untracked/ignored files and is not GitHub content.
